title: Lambda as an SQS consumer (batching, partial failure, and scaling)
hook: An Lambda event source mapping polls your SQS queue and invokes the function with a batch of messages. Batching improves throughput but complicates error handling — partial batch failure reporting retries only the failed items.

blocks.text: Lambda polls SQS on your behalf, passing an event with Records array. Configuration includes batchSize (1–10), maximumBatchingWindow, functionResponseType ReportBatchItemFailures, and scaling behavior tied to account concurrency. Lambda deletes successfully processed messages; failures return to queue per partial batch rules.

entries.plainDefinition: AWS-managed link between SQS queue and Lambda function.
entries.example: UUID mapping with batchSize 10 on orders queue.

entries.plainDefinition: Max messages per Lambda invocation (up to 10 for SQS).
Lambda response listing only failed message IDs for retry.
Guaranteed or capped parallel executions for a function.
entries.example: Reserved 50 — queue drains at most 50 concurrent.

blocks.text: Default batch failure retries the entire batch — nine good messages reprocessed because one failed. Reserved concurrency set too low starves the queue; too high without downstream capacity overloads RDS. VPC Lambda adds cold start latency that can interact badly with tight visibility timeouts.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: enable ReportBatchItemFailures, tune batchSize to failure blast radius, match visibility to timeout × 6, watch ConcurrentExecutions vs queue age.

snippet.label: CloudFormation — event source mapping with partial failure
snippet.code:
Resources:
  OrderProcessorMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessor
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
      FunctionResponseTypes:
        - ReportBatchItemFailures
snippet.explanation: FunctionResponseTypes enables partial batch. Batching window trades latency for fuller batches.

snippet.label: TypeScript — partial batch failure handler
snippet.explanation: Only failed messageIds retry. Successful records deleted by Lambda runtime automatically.

snippet.label: CLI — set reserved concurrency cap
snippet.explanation: Caps max parallel invocations — protects downstream DB from unbounded scale-up.

snippet.label: CLI — check mapping and queue lag metrics
snippet.code:
aws lambda list-event-source-mappings \
  --function-name order-processor

aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics \
  --namespace AWS/SQS \
  --metric-name ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage \
  --dimensions Name=QueueName,Value=orders \
  --start-time $(date -u -v-1H +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \
  --end-time $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) \
  --period 300 --statistics Maximum
snippet.explanation: Correlate mapping state with oldest message age to prove consumer lag during incident.

blocks.title: Lambda SQS trigger versus manual poll loop
Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Throwing uncaught exception with full batch — all messages retry. batchSize 10 on poison-prone payloads. No reserved concurrency on DB-bound handler. VPC Lambda without provisioned concurrency on latency-sensitive queue.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: dashboard ConcurrentExecutions + ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage + Errors. Throttles metric with rising queue depth means account or reserved concurrency limit. VPC cold start shows in InitDuration — correlate with message age spikes after scale-from-zero.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'Lambda auto-scales so queue depth does not matter.' Strong answer: concurrency limits, downstream bottlenecks, and partial batch failure handling all cap effective drain rate.

interviewTakeaways: Event source mapping polls SQS; batchSize and batching window tune throughput versus latency.
ReportBatchItemFailures retries only failed messages — required for batchSize > 1.
Reserved concurrency protects downstream or caps drain rate — not always 'max scale'.
60s: Partial batch failures. batchSize tradeoff. Visibility 6× timeout. Concurrency vs queue age dashboard.
Follow-up: how does VPC affect Lambda SQS consumer cold starts?
commonPitfalls: Uncaught exception retries entire batch of 10 — rejection answer without ReportBatchItemFailures.
Strong answer: return batchItemFailures array with failed messageIds only.
Unlimited concurrency melting RDS connection pool.
Ignoring InitDuration spikes on VPC-attached consumers.

jsTsCorrelations.note: SQSHandler batch loop mirrors C# Lambda runtime with IEnumerable<SQSEvent.SQSMessage> — or a self-hosted BackgroundService processing a pulled batch with parallel ForEachAsync.
Powertools partial response utility wraps the same batchItemFailures pattern — reduces boilerplate versus raw SQSHandler.
